metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Laos on February 3, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) dataset: "FIRMS" in GEE - Actually, the correct collection is "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" or "MODIS/061/MOD14A1" for daily fire product - Better: Use "FIRMS" collection which is specifically for active fires: ee.ImageCollection("FIRMS") - Actually the correct one is: ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/006/MOD14A1") or ee.FeatureCollection("FIRMS") if it exists - Let me use the MODIS active fire product: "MODIS/061/MCD14DL" which is a FeatureCollection of fire detections - Date: February 3, 2018 (single day) - Location: Cambodia and Laos geometries 2. Masking strategy: - This is about fire detections, so no cloud masking needed - We're counting fire detection points/pixels 3. Logic: - Count fire detections in Cambodia vs Laos - If Cambodia count > Laos count: A (Yes) - If Cambodia count <= Laos count: B (No) - If no data for either country: C1 - If data exists but counts are invalid: C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]] ]) laos = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[100.1, 13.9], [107.7, 13.9], [107.7, 22.5], [100.1, 22.5], [100.1, 13.9]] ]) date_start = '2018-02-03' date_end = '2018-02-04' # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire Product (FeatureCollection) fires = ee.FeatureCollection("MODIS/006/MCD14DL").filter( ee.Filter.date(date_start, date_end) ) # Check if data exists total_fires = fires.size().getInfo() print(f"Total fire detections on 2018-02-03: {total_fires}") if total_fires == 0: print("No fire data available for this date.") print("C1") else: # 3. Count fires in each country fires_cambodia = fires.filterBounds(cambodia) fires_laos = fires.filterBounds(laos) count_cambodia = fires_cambodia.size().getInfo() count_laos = fires_laos.size().getInfo() print(f"Cambodia fire detections: {count_cambodia}") print(f"Laos fire detections: {count_laos}") # 4. Validation & Final Answer if count_cambodia is None or count_laos is None: print("Calculation failed - invalid counts.") print("C3") elif count_cambodia == 0 and count_laos == 0: print("No fires detected in either country.") print("C2") elif count_cambodia > count_laos: print("Cambodia had more active fire detections than Laos.") print("A") else: print("Cambodia did not have more active fire detections than Laos.") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]]
])

laos = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[100.1, 13.9], [107.7, 13.9], [107.7, 22.5], [100.1, 22.5], [100.1, 13.9]]
])

date_start = '2018-02-03'
date_end = '2018-02-04'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire Product (FeatureCollection)
fires = ee.FeatureCollection("MODIS/006/MCD14DL").filter(
    ee.Filter.date(date_start, date_end)
)

# Check if data exists
total_fires = fires.size().getInfo()
print(f"Total fire detections on 2018-02-03: {total_fires}")

if total_fires == 0:
    print("No fire data available for this date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Count fires in each country
    fires_cambodia = fires.filterBounds(cambodia)
    fires_laos = fires.filterBounds(laos)
    
    count_cambodia = fires_cambodia.size().getInfo()
    count_laos = fires_laos.size().getInfo()
    
    print(f"Cambodia fire detections: {count_cambodia}")
    print(f"Laos fire detections: {count_laos}")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if count_cambodia is None or count_laos is None:
        print("Calculation failed - invalid counts.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif count_cambodia == 0 and count_laos == 0:
        print("No fires detected in either country.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif count_cambodia > count_laos:
        print("Cambodia had more active fire detections than Laos.")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("Cambodia did not have more active fire detections than Laos.")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
